_comment: Pins the Microsoft Graph OpenAPI specs this client is generated from.
Without a pin, `npm run generate` fetched refs/heads/master, so CI built against
whatever Microsoft had published that minute while a developer checkout silently
reused an older copy on disk. The same commit could produce different clients, and
nothing recorded which spec was used. See EnviroKinetics/ms365-mcp#27.
To refresh: run `npm run generate -- --refresh-spec`, which fetches master, reports
the new ref and digests, and writes them here. Review the resulting client diff as
you would any other dependency bump, then commit this file with it.
